author: JeffmiTheX
quote:
If I could write more than 5000 characters on this website, I would be happy to do so. This game is the symbol of the ending of physical media, and this is the best that Sony and Rockstar can do to justify the option of physical media being taken away,

First of all, this is proof that game journalists are completely censored for being vocal about games that all the multibillion-dollar companies release. They will give the most positive review of all time in order not to be blacklisted, then wait for everyone to give what they genuinely thought about this game, and then let the "fanboys" give the game a good review, despite the consensus being that GTA VI didn't reach our expectations and that it totally destroyed what made GTA... "GTA".

It is an insult to even call this game "The game of the Year", or even the most anticipated game of all time, when what the bare minimum that Rockstar can do for their ultimate editions is asking the gamers to pay 100$ for barely anything behind this version, when not delivering anything, to this game to justify the insane price that cost all the groceries of the week.

It should be a shame to call this game a sequel to GTA V, when all this game does is deliver a simulator game where you can't even commit crimes anymore (not to many) in order to not shift the story, when this wasn't a thing in previous GTA games, and having the ability to steal high-end cars locked behind the progression of the story. You can only steal low-end cars, when once again, stealing every car was the main premise of previous GTA games, and also the fact that your car will come to a stop when running out of gas, and have to pay with your own money to keep it running again, and the repair as well, I guess cars can't restore themselves anymore, some people will say, I bet.

Let's not forget that all of the "arcady" mechanics of this that made GTA games iconic have been completely stripped away from this game in favor of realism, when most of the people on this platform just wanna lose themselves and have fun playing video games. This is what makes video games a hobby for everyone to enjoy, but the concept of realism is the main objective for Rockstar to achieve in order to satisfy their shareholders, which wasn't well received.

The 30 fps debate should not be an excuse to look at your customers and say "yeah, let's add more people to the beach and make anything choppy in order to put the PS5/Xbox to its limits" when the games are struggling to even hit 30 fps because it was targeted to be this way, by Rockstar. The game struggles to hit that number and sometimes, in the worst-case scenario, would drop to 25 to 15 fps. I could only imagine how much the framerate will be online in this game when GTA Online will be released to the public.

This game is filled with bugs, like Cyberpunk 2077. While this might be a terrible comparison to some people, they both have things in common: They were overhyped and praised by the public before the game was released. The only difference was that Playstation took Cyberpunk off the store and refunded their customers. With GTA VI on the market, I wonder why they won't give any refunds anymore, aside from being "digital only" and just "codes in the box". It's a bit strange that Sony would go down this path just for this game, in order to keep the customers money that they work so hard to get, just to be taken away by all the multibillion-dollar corporations, just for them to keep doing their bad business practices

With my thoughts left out of my chest, I want you, the reader, to remind you that no matter what game you love, the "fanboys" and journalists will always add some false reviews just to increase its score. It's up to you to play the game, or at the very best, watch some gameplay around any games, and give your thoughts in order to spread your words to other people.

My score number I gave on GTA VI might not represent the actual game, but just know that I didn't play this game. My sources to inform myself about any video games are to watch gameplays of other people on social media and make my own thoughts and get them out of my chest for you to read and review. I might make some spelling mistakes here and there, but what is more important is leaving a message, so people can understand you.

With not many characters left. I would like to say that this game isn't worth being "Game of the Year" or being "the greatest game of all time". For me, a great game isn't about taking away the features it had back in the days; otherwise, this would be a game that no one or the fans who love this game series would enjoy playing, or getting new people to enjoy the game and make them learn more about previous games.

If you made it all the way to the end, you are a good reader, who takes his time to read anyone's points and gather them one by one and make his own thoughts about them, to help everyone be informed about many topics around the world while having skepticism.
